init.title: HofKarte settings
init.description: Default sort order for the overview, and the default search radius for "auto-fill" (OpenStreetMap).

hoflaeden_suchen.name: Search farm shops
hoflaeden_suchen.description: Search and filter the farm shops managed in HofKarte. All given filters are combined with AND.

suchbegriff.name: Search term
suchbegriff.description: Free-text search (case-insensitive) across name, description and town.

angebot.name: Offer
angebot.description: Only farm shops with this exact offer/product name.

zahlungsart.name: Payment method
zahlungsart.description: Only farm shops accepting this exact payment method.

nur_geoeffnet.name: Only currently open
nur_geoeffnet.description: If set, only farm shops that are currently open are returned.

hoflaeden_in_naehe.name: Farm shops nearby
hoflaeden_in_naehe.description: Returns farm shops within a radius around an arbitrary location, sorted by distance. Basis for a proximity notification based on the actual device location.

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the reference point (e.g. from a person/device_tracker entity).

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude of the reference point (e.g. from a person/device_tracker entity).

radius_meter.name: Radius
radius_meter.description: Search radius in meters around the reference point.

nur_geoeffnet.name: Only currently open
nur_geoeffnet.description: If set, only farm shops that are currently open are returned.

min_bewertung.name: Minimum rating
min_bewertung.description: If set, only farm shops with a rating of at least this value are returned (0–5, simple "favorites only" filter).
